passive_description.localized: Increases the wearer's Basic Attack DMG by <lv>{1}</> for <lv>{0}</>s after each Basic Attack, up to <lv>10</> stacks. Each stack lasts independently.
passive_description.source: 装备者每次「普通攻击」造成伤害后<lv>{0}</>秒内，自身「普通攻击」伤害提升<lv>{1}</>，最多叠加<lv>10</>层，每层效果单独结算持续时间。

tested_hypotheses: Native delivered damage source category A triggers stacks independently of input role and element; delivered categories other than A do not trigger.
Each connected packet/target adds one stack after delivery; children already queued for the same timestamp use the pre-callback stack state.
Stacks expire independently after ten seconds of world time; a trigger at cap is discarded and does not refresh active stack lifetimes.
Stacks remain owned by the weapon wearer while switched out; an ally's A-category hits do not trigger or receive this wearer's passive.
Defeated-target and zero-damage delivery do not activate a stack; exact expiry is processed before an equal-time hit.
